points.title: 童年与成长
points.description: 塔可夫斯基出生于俄罗斯伊万诺沃州的一个知识分子家庭，父亲是著名诗人阿尔谢尼·塔可夫斯基，母亲是翻译家玛丽亚·维尼阿米诺夫娜。童年时期经历了二战的艰难岁月，这段经历深刻影响了他后来的电影创作。他的家庭环境培养了他对文学和艺术的浓厚兴趣，尤其是父亲的影响使他从小就接触到诗歌和文学。这段时期的生活经历为他日后电影中的诗意表达和哲学思考奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Ivanovo Oblast, Russia, to a family of intellectuals—his father was the renowned poet Arseny Tarkovsky and his mother a translator Maria Vyshinskaya. Tarkovsky's childhood was marked by the hardships of World War II, experiences that profoundly influenced his later film work. His family environment nurtured his deep interest in literature and arts, particularly his father's influence exposing him to poetry and literature from an early age. These formative years laid the foundation for the poetic expression and philosophical depth that would characterize his cinema.

points.title: 电影学习时期
points.description: 塔可夫斯基进入莫斯科国立电影学院学习，师从著名导演米哈伊尔·罗姆。在这期间，他接触并吸收了欧洲艺术电影的传统，同时深入研究俄罗斯文学和哲学。他的毕业作品《今天停工，明天继续》获得了好评，这部短片已经展现了他独特的视觉风格和对时间、记忆等主题的关注。这一时期的学习经历为他日后的创作奠定了坚实的理论基础和技术基础，同时也形成了他独特的电影美学观念。
points.descriptionEn: Tarkovsky studied at the Moscow Film Institute (VGIK) under the renowned director Mikhail Romm. During this period, he absorbed the traditions of European art cinema while deeply studying Russian literature and philosophy. His graduation film 'There Will Be No Leave Today' received critical acclaim, already showcasing his distinctive visual style and thematic concerns about time and memory. This educational period provided him with a solid theoretical and technical foundation for his future work while shaping his unique cinematic aesthetic.

points.title: 早期创作
points.description: 毕业后，塔可夫斯基在莫斯科开始了他的导演生涯。1962年，他执导了第一部长片《伊凡的童年》，这部作品获得了威尼斯电影节金狮奖，为他赢得了国际声誉。影片通过一个战争孤儿的故事，探讨了战争对人性的摧残，以及记忆与现实的复杂关系。这部电影确立了塔可夫斯基作为苏联电影界新锐导演的地位，同时也展现了他独特的视觉语言和哲学思考。这一时期的成功为他赢得了更多的创作自由和资源支持。
points.descriptionEn: After graduation, Tarkovsky began his directing career in Moscow. In 1962, he directed his first feature film 'Ivan's Childhood,' which won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival, establishing his international reputation. The film explores the devastation of war on humanity through the story of a war orphan, examining the complex relationship between memory and reality. This work solidified Tarkovsky's position as a promising new director in Soviet cinema while showcasing his distinctive visual language and philosophical depth. The success of this period granted him greater creative freedom and resources.

points.title: 艺术成熟期
points.description: 这一时期，塔可夫斯基创作了他最具代表性的作品《安德烈·卢布廖夫》。这部耗时五年完成的电影，通过15世纪俄罗斯画家卢布廖夫的一生，探讨了艺术创作、信仰与暴力之间的关系。影片以其独特的叙事结构和诗意的影像语言，成为世界电影史上的经典之作。然而，由于影片对历史和宗教的复杂处理，它在苏联国内遭遇了审查困难，直到多年后才完整上映。这一时期的创作挑战进一步深化了塔可夫斯基对电影艺术本质的思考，也使他开始面临与官方意识形态的紧张关系。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Tarkovsky created his most representative work 'Andrei Rublev.' This five-year epic film explores the relationship between art, faith, and violence through the life of 15th-century Russian painter Andrei Rublev. With its unique narrative structure and poetic visual language, the film has become a classic in world cinema history. However, due to its complex treatment of history and religion, the film faced censorship difficulties in the Soviet Union and wasn't shown in its complete form for many years. The creative challenges of this period deepened Tarkovsky's thinking about the essence of cinematic art and intensified his tensions with official ideology.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 塔可夫斯基在这一时期创作了他的另一部杰作《镜子》。这部高度个人化的电影通过碎片化的叙事和梦境般的影像，探讨了记忆、历史、家庭关系等主题。影片采用了创新的叙事结构，将过去、现在和未来交织在一起，展现了塔可夫斯基独特的电影语言。然而，由于影片的非传统叙事方式和强烈的个人色彩，它在苏联国内再次遭遇了审查困难。这一时期的创作进一步确立了塔可夫斯基作为世界级艺术电影大师的地位，同时也加剧了他与苏联当局的矛盾，为他后来的离开埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Tarkovsky created another masterpiece during this period: 'Mirror.' This highly personal film explores themes of memory, history, and family relationships through fragmented narratives and dreamlike imagery. The film employs an innovative narrative structure, weaving together past, present, and future, showcasing Tarkovsky's unique cinematic language. However, due to its unconventional narrative approach and strong personal character, the film once again faced censorship difficulties in the Soviet Union. This period further solidified Tarkovsky's status as a world-class art film master while intensifying his conflicts with Soviet authorities, paving the way for his later departure.

points.title: 流亡岁月
points.description: 由于与苏联当局的矛盾日益加深，塔可夫斯基于1979年离开苏联，开始了流亡生涯。他在意大利和瑞典继续创作，完成了《潜行者》、《乡愁》和《牺牲》等重要作品。这些作品继续探讨了他一贯关注的主题：时间、记忆、信仰和人类存在的意义，但更加个人化和哲学化。流亡生活虽然给了他创作自由，但也带来了巨大的精神压力和经济困难。1986年，塔可夫斯基在巴黎因肺癌去世，终年54岁。他的离世标志着世界电影史上一位独特艺术家的消失，但他的作品和电影理念对后世产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Due to intensifying conflicts with Soviet authorities, Tarkovsky left the Soviet Union in 1979, beginning an exile period. He continued his work in Italy and Sweden, completing important films such as 'Stalker,' 'Nostalghia,' and 'The Sacrifice.' These works continued to explore his recurring themes—time, memory, faith, and the meaning of human existence—but became increasingly personal and philosophical. While exile provided creative freedom, it also brought significant mental stress and financial difficulties. In 1986, Tarkovsky died of lung cancer in Paris at the age of 54. His death marked the loss of a unique artist in world cinema history, but his work and cinematic philosophy have had a profound influence on future generations.

appraisal.zh: 塔可夫斯基被公认为电影史上最伟大的诗人导演之一，他以长镜头、缓慢节奏和诗意影像把电影提升到哲学与艺术的高度，对时间、记忆与人类存在的思索使他成为艺术电影的精神标杆，其理念深刻影响了伯格曼、安哲罗普洛斯等后世导演。不过也有研究者指出，他的作品晦涩缓慢、叙事张力薄弱，过于个人化而难以与普通观众共鸣，处理历史与政治议题时亦显抽象，其美学有时被看作精英主义，限制了作品的社会影响。
appraisal.en: Tarkovsky is widely regarded as one of cinema's greatest poetic directors, elevating film to a philosophical and artistic height through long takes, slow pacing and poetic imagery; his meditations on time, memory and human existence made him a spiritual benchmark of art cinema, and his ideas deeply influenced later directors such as Bergman and Angelopoulos. Yet some researchers note that his films are obscure and slow, thin in narrative tension and too personal to resonate with general audiences, and that his treatment of historical and political themes remains abstract, his aesthetic sometimes seen as elitist, limiting the social reach of his work.

supporter.zh: 塔可夫斯基被视为电影史上最伟大的诗人导演之一，他的作品将电影提升到了哲学和艺术的最高境界。他的电影语言独特，通过长镜头、缓慢的节奏和诗意的影像，创造出超越时间的艺术体验。塔可夫斯基对电影本质的探索，对时间、记忆和人类存在的深刻思考，使他成为艺术电影的精神领袖。他的电影不仅是视觉的盛宴，更是灵魂的探索，为后世导演树立了艺术创作的标杆。
supporter.en: Tarkovsky is regarded as one of the greatest poetic directors in film history, elevating cinema to its highest philosophical and artistic expression. His unique cinematic language, characterized by long takes, slow pacing, and poetic imagery, creates artistic experiences that transcend time. Tarkovsky's exploration of cinema's essence, his profound reflections on time, memory, and human existence, establish him as a spiritual leader of art cinema. His films are not only visual feasts but also journeys of the soul, setting a standard for artistic creation for future generations.

critic.zh: 批评者认为塔可夫斯基的电影过于晦涩难懂，节奏缓慢，缺乏叙事张力。他的作品常常被指责为自我 indulgent，过于个人化而难以引起普通观众的共鸣。此外，塔可夫斯基在处理历史和政治议题时，有时被认为过于抽象和脱离现实，缺乏具体的社会批判。他的电影美学虽然独特，但也可能被视为精英主义和脱离大众文化的表现，限制了其作品的社会影响力和传播范围。
critic.en: Critics argue that Tarkovsky's films are often obscure and difficult to understand, with slow pacing lacking narrative tension. His work is sometimes accused of being self-indulgent and overly personal, failing to resonate with general audiences. Furthermore, in addressing historical and political themes, Tarkovsky is considered too abstract and detached from reality, lacking concrete social critique. While his cinematic aesthetic is distinctive, it may be viewed as elitist and disconnected from popular culture, limiting the social impact and reach of his work.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，塔可夫斯基被定义为电影艺术革新者，他的作品对世界电影产生了深远影响。他的电影理念影响了无数导演，包括英格玛·伯格曼、西奥·安哲罗普洛斯等大师级人物。塔可夫斯基的电影被视为苏联电影艺术的巅峰之作，也是世界电影史上不可忽视的重要遗产。在当代流行文化中，他的名字已成为艺术电影的代名词，代表着对电影艺术本质的探索和对人类精神世界的关注。他的作品虽然受众有限，但其艺术价值和哲学深度使其成为电影研究的重要对象。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Tarkovsky is defined as a cinematic innovator whose work has profoundly influenced world cinema. His cinematic philosophy has influenced countless directors, including masters like Ingmar Bergman and Theo Angelopoulos. Tarkovsky's films are regarded as pinnacles of Soviet cinematic art and an indispensable part of world film heritage. In contemporary popular culture, his name has become synonymous with art cinema, representing an exploration of cinema's essence and concern for the human spirit. While his audience may be limited, the artistic value and philosophical depth of his work make him a significant subject of film studies.

self.zh: 电影不是一种记录现实的方式，而是一种创造现实的手段。
self.en: Cinema is not a way to record reality, but a means of creating it.
